d:
I recently returned to the London School of Economics, 13 years after attending a summer course there, this time for a fireside chat with students.
We spoke about India's place in the world, the identity of Indians living abroad, immigration, geopolitics, and how AI is changing the way we think about work and ambition.
We also discussed how India is perceived globally, why more Indians need to participate in conversations about the world, and why we should be shaping these conversations ourselves.
A conversation about identity, ambition, belonging and India's place in a changing world.
